newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim gets approval for Rafako stake.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim gets approval for Rafako stake.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has no objection to industrial and trading firm Elektrim's taking a stake of over 50 percent in industrial boilermaker Rafako, the KPW said in a statement.

"After receiving the opinion of the Office for Competition and Consumer Protection (the anti-monopoly office) the Securities Commission has...expressed no objection to Elektrim's intention to buy...a share package guaranteeing more than 50 percent of shareholder votes," the statement said.
Last month Rafako shareholders aproved a new issue of 8.07 million shares for Elektrim at 11.25 zlotys each, which would give Elektrim a 46-percent stake in Rafako.
After the issue Rafako's capital would be divided into 17.4 million shares.
On Thursday Rafako shares traded at 13 zlotys.
